title: Sources: Anthropic has lined up $5B to $6B for an employee share sale at a valuation of about $350B; outside investors will be buying up the insider shares (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic has lined up $5B to $6B for an employee share sale at a valuation of about $350B; outside investors will be buying up the insider shares — Anthropic is offering some current and former employees the ability to sell shares in the company at a valuation of about $350 billion …
